Downtown Core & Main Street.name: Downtown Core & Main Street
Downtown Core & Main Street.description: CBD towers and Deep Ellum edge where ROW/permit velocity tracks transit-oriented redevelopment along the DART core.

Deep Ellum.name: Deep Ellum
Deep Ellum.description: Music-venue and adaptive-reuse district east of the core, mixed-use infill driving small-lot ROW work.

Baylor & Cedars.name: Baylor & Cedars
Baylor & Cedars.description: Medical-district-adjacent residential conversion belt with hospital-anchored demand and steady renovation permits.

Uptown & West Village.name: Uptown & West Village
Uptown & West Village.description: Streetcar-era high-density multifamily spine with the metro's densest vertical construction outside downtown.

Oak Lawn & Turtle Creek.name: Oak Lawn & Turtle Creek
Oak Lawn & Turtle Creek.description: Established estate-and-highrise corridor with teardown-rebuild mansions and luxury mid-rise permitting.

Victory Park.name: Victory Park
Victory Park.description: Arena-and-residential mixed-use node northwest of downtown with ground-up tower activity.

Preston Hollow.name: Preston Hollow
Preston Hollow.description: Hill-country estate stock with teardown-rebuild mansions dominating a low-volume, high-value permit mix.

Preston Center & Bluffview.name: Preston Center & Bluffview
Preston Center & Bluffview.description: Office-to-residential conversion belt and cottage-grid neighborhoods under the Preston overlay.

North Dallas & LBJ Freeway.name: North Dallas & LBJ Freeway
North Dallas & LBJ Freeway.description: Freeway-adjacent commercial edge with mid-rise multifamily replacements of aging retail and office stock.

White Rock Lake.name: White Rock Lake
White Rock Lake.description: Park-adjacent post-war residential hills drawing renovation capital from greenbelt access.

Lake Highlands.name: Lake Highlands
Lake Highlands.description: Suburban-style subdivisions along the northeastern growth spine, permitted through Dallas rather than Richardson.

East Dallas & Lower Greenville.name: East Dallas & Lower Greenville
East Dallas & Lower Greenville.description: Indie-retail strip meeting streetcar-era bungalow stock, renovation-led permits under neighborhood overlays.

Bishop Arts District.name: Bishop Arts District
Bishop Arts District.description: Boutique retail and hotel flagship corridor with infill multifamily on its side streets in North Oak Cliff.

Kessler & Stevens Park.name: Kessler & Stevens Park
Kessler & Stevens Park.description: Hill-country estate stock at the Oak Cliff village boundary with teardown-rebuild pressure.

South Dallas & Fair Park.name: South Dallas & Fair Park
South Dallas & Fair Park.description: Fair Park-adjacent redevelopment belt with renovation-heavy permitting and historic-district overlays.

Highland Park.name: Highland Park
Highland Park.description: Incorporated estate enclave inside Dallas with teardown-rebuild mansions dominating a low-volume, high-value mix.

University Park.name: University Park
University Park.description: SMU-anchored residential enclave with renovation-led permits and strict tree/single-family overlays.

Highland Park Village Edge.name: Highland Park Village Edge
Highland Park Village Edge.description: Retail-and-residential node at the Park Cities boundary, ground-up luxury mixed-use on side streets.
